- **Background Methods**:
  - Control-region-based background normalisation fit
  - Data-driven misidentified-lepton estimate using an anti-identified control sample
  - MC simulation normalised to theoretical (SM) prediction

- **Event Regions**:
  - Top control region (VBF analysis)
  - Top control region (ggF + 2 jets analysis)
  - VBF signal region
  - WW control region (ggF + 2 jets analysis)
  - Z->tautau control region (VBF analysis)
  - Z->tautau control region (ggF + 2 jets analysis)
  - ggF + 2 jets signal region

  - (a_L, a_T) = (0.7, 1.3) benchmark
  - (a_L, a_T) = (1, 1) SM benchmark
  - (a_L, a_T) = (1, 1.3) benchmark
  - (a_L, a_T) = (1.3, 0.7) benchmark
  - (a_L, a_T) = (1.3, 1) benchmark
  - CP-even (SM) benchmark: kappa_gg=1, cos(alpha)=1
  - CP-mixed benchmark: kappa_gg=1, cos(alpha)=1/sqrt(2)
  - CP-odd benchmark (\( \alpha=90^{\circ} \))

- **Model Parameters**:
  - \( a_L \)
  - \( a_T \)
  - \( \alpha \) (CP-mixing angle)
  - \( \epsilon_{VV} \)
  - \( \kappa_{VV} \)
  - \( \kappa_{gg} \)

This analysis is part of a comprehensive study of the Higgs boson's properties, focusing on CP-mixing angles and various benchmarks to explore the CP-odd and CP-even components of the Higgs coupling.
